mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's tightening response (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) leads to reduced corporate profit margins and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and monetary tightening (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, FEDFUNDS > 4.5%)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average by more than 1.0% signals weak consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when RSAFS declines by more than 1.0% below 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% YoY signals disinflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM growth < 0.1% and UNRATE MoM increase > 0.2%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS MoM growth < 0.1% and UNRATE MoM increase > 0.2%.
